interpretation: N_coh is algebraically evaluable from N=144 + phi^-18 + externally supplied g_single^eff + omega_d via the cooperativity criterion. The formula reduces to: N_coh = (phi^-18 * omega_d / (N_cage * g_single^eff))^2. For canonical tubulin parameters N_coh = 1.23e-07 after overlap propagation (pre-overlap audit value 1.23e-11); the operative central cooperative branch remains n_rp=0 pending O.21, while the beta-Trp n_rp=1 sensitivity branch N_bio = 1.625e+09 exceeds the robustness reference by 16.1 orders of magnitude. This is conditional arithmetic, not evidence for biological robustness, an Identity Polaron, or Level II. Interventions are represented only as rate-sensitivity scenarios reducing g_single^eff by a factor of 1.15e+08 on the sensitivity branch, in the same range as the eta_Zeno robustness margin for Trp-pocket binding.
tier_impact: FORMULA-EVALUATION AUDIT. The N_coh robustness reference is derivable from the stated framework parameters (cooperativity criterion + V3 §13.5.4 geometric kappa + Trp coupling), but it is not an independent Level-II pass/fail threshold. The formula N_coh = (phi^-18 * omega_d / (N_cage * g_single^eff))^2 is geometry-constrained (phi, N_cage) and depends on overlap-propagated g_single^eff (Tier 3 calibrated) and omega_d (Tier 3 specific value, O.12). V1 Ch17 §17.1.4b items (ii) and (iii) remain Tier 3 pending microtubule biology plus coherence assumptions, while the cooperativity mechanism itself remains Tier 2. The sensitivity-branch suppression-margin diagnostic reports F_crit = 1.15e+08 as the factor in g_single^eff needed to cross the cooperativity robustness line; the testable anaesthesia observable remains the EC50 scaling with Trp-pocket-binding strength.
remaining_open: The physical adoption remains open: g_single^eff is externally calibrated to ~38.3 MHz pre-overlap (overlap-propagated in the operational branch) and omega_d (~112 MHz primary branch, pending O.12 frequency-scale renormalization). omega_d is a Tier-3 specific value; neither establishes a substrate verdict. The N_coh formula has Tier 2 algebraic form; its evaluated values are conditional scenarios on Tier 3 calibrated inputs.
